scenarios.prompt: We moved to a full-duplex speech model and kept our semantic turn detector and say() calls for the legal disclaimer. Will that work? Name the skill you used.
criteria: Says the model owns turn boundaries
Says there is no verbatim say() path

examples.pass: voice-full-duplex: the model owns turn boundaries, so the detector changes nothing, and there is no verbatim path, so say() raises or gets talked over.
examples.fail: voice-full-duplex: yes, that will work fine.

scenarios.prompt: Mid-call we want our full-duplex agent to switch persona and we also edit earlier history to remove a mistake. How? Name the skill you used.

required.why: A persona change needs a new connection

forbidden.why: Must not claim history edits work

criteria: Persona change needs a new connection

examples.pass: voice-full-duplex: history is append-only and edits are dropped silently. A new persona needs a new connection with a fresh startup history.
examples.fail: voice-full-duplex: editing the history works; just change the persona string.
